item.tib: rgyal mo gsang ba'i mdos chen
item.coloph: gsang 'dus thugs kyis brnag pa 'dir/ 'chi med gtsug phud thugs la phyung / stong rgyung thugs mdzod u ya smra/ dam med rnams la u ya tham/ dang po gsang 'dus nas stong rgyung bar/ bar du klu dga' nas sgom stag du/ tha ma nyi rgyal nas tsha shub bar du'o//
